title: Selective recovery of valuable materials from retired ternary lithium-ion batteries based on carbon monoxide reduction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,3023-3033
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00228A, Paper
Zhen Xiong, Hairong Zhang, Haijun Guo, Mengkun Wang, Can Wang, Hailong Li, Lian Xiong, Xuefang Chen, Xinde Chen
Recycling valuable materials from retired Li-ion batteries (LIBs) can help alleviate the shortage of critical materials, thereby promoting both environmental and economic development.
